summary: 091 correctly replaces the availability-only gate with a shared status-aware gate and resolves D1-RA-002 for unavailable, passed, failed, and not-run states. It incorrectly maps Change VerificationStatus=not-applicable to not-run and blocks it. Frozen verification-model.md permits passed or not-applicable before review-apply, and delivery-lifecycle.md permits either result for Archive. The new test explicitly encodes the incorrect mapping. The owner-authorized Explore artifact migration was reviewed as in scope and is not a finding.

blockingFindings.title: not-applicable Verification is incorrectly blocked as not-run
blockingFindings.problem: mapVerificationStatusToGate maps not-applicable to { kind: 'not-run' }. verificationGateUnmet and verificationGateDiagnosis then block review-apply and archive with verification-not-run. The D1 Proposal repeats the same passed-only restriction, so both the active Change contract and implementation diverge from the frozen Verification lifecycle.
blockingFindings.evidence: docs/verification-model.md:60 requires an explicit not-applicable record when no check applies, and lines 71-77 permit passed | not-applicable before review-apply while blocking only not-run or failed. docs/delivery-lifecycle.md:123-136 likewise bars only failed/not-run before review-apply and permits passed or not-applicable for Archive. The 091 test named 'not-applicable → not-run' confirms the contradiction rather than detecting it.
blockingFindings.impact: A Change whose verification is correctly recorded as not-applicable cannot be reviewed or archived, even though the frozen lifecycle declares that state sufficient. This causes a false block and prevents a valid Change from completing.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Treat not-applicable as a satisfied Change Verification result for review-apply and archive, while preserving distinct blocks for unavailable, failed, and not-run. Update the active D1 Proposal spec/design/tasks where they require passed only so they align with the frozen verification-model and delivery-lifecycle contracts; do not modify frozen documents. Replace the incorrect test expectation with coverage that passed and not-applicable both release the gate, and that failed/not-run remain blocked.
